scenario.topic: Choose the fundraising dish for the school bake sale

options.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
options.upside: Widely liked and easy to package for sale.
options.concern: Requires baking time and oven space.

options.name: Lemon Bars
options.upside: Offers a tangy alternative to traditional sweets.
options.concern: Longer preparation and cooling time needed.

options.name: Banana Bread
options.upside: Uses overripe bananas and has a moist texture.
options.concern: Lower number of servings per batch.

options.name: Rice Krispies Treats
options.upside: Quick to prepare with no baking required.
options.concern: Less variety in flavor compared to baked goods.

shared_context: The school bake sale aims to raise funds by selling popular homemade dishes. Five participants will decide on one dish to prepare, considering preparation time, ingredient cost, and general appeal to students and parents.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a parent volunteer who values quick and easy-to-make treats for busy bake sales.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the dish is fast to prepare and appeals to most students.

A.reason_for: Widely liked and easy to package for sale.
A.reason_against: Requires baking time and oven space, which slows prep.

B.reason_for: Offers a tangy alternative to traditional sweets.
B.reason_against: Longer preparation and cooling time makes it less practical.

C.reason_for: Uses overripe bananas and has a moist texture.
C.reason_against: Lower number of servings per batch and longer prep time.

D.reason_for: Quick to prepare with no baking required, ideal for busy schedules.
